svg.aria-label: Detector coverage: reliable for email, IP address, valid cards and IBANs, AWS keys, GitHub tokens, JWTs, private keys; partial for names in English and other languages, US SSNs, phone numbers, street addresses, national ids, passwords in text; weak for names in non-Latin scripts, lower-case names, ids with no id word
svg.title: Detector coverage: reliable for email, IP address, valid cards and IBANs, AWS keys, GitHub tokens, JWTs, private keys; partial for names in English and other languages, US SSNs, phone numbers, street addresses, national ids, passwords in text; weak for names in non-Latin scripts, lower-case names, ids with no id word
